blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Commission on Elections (Comelec) has once again dismissed resurfacing claims that there will be a “no-el” (no elections) scenario in 2028 as it emphasized that the poll body is currently preparing for the much-anticipated elections. In an interview with dzBB on Sunday, Comelec chair George Erwin Garcia was asked about recent claims that there will be no elections in 2028. “Imposibleng mangyari. Ang Saligang Batas ang nagsasabing may eleksyon sa 2028. Walang kahit na anong batas ang pwedeng gawin ng kongreso, pirmahan ng pangulo ang makakapagbago sa Saligang Batas.
